questionText:
Arrange the three sequential stages of Hans Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome (GAS) in correct order:

(A) Alarm Reaction Stage
(B) Resistance Stage
(C) Exhaustion Stage

Choose the correct sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Hans Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome (GAS) progresses through three invariant stages: (1) Alarm Reaction stage (activation of fight-or-flight mechanisms) -> (2) Resistance stage (body adapts to ongoing stress) -> (3) Exhaustion stage (depletion of bodily reserves).
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
